name: eventshub
description: Upcoming public events in Cyprus: concerts, theatre, festivals, exhibitions, workshops and family events, with dates, venues, prices and links.

interface.longDescription:
eventshub is the events guide for Cyprus: concerts, theatre, festivals, exhibitions, workshops, food events and family activities across Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca, Paphos, Famagusta and the mountains.

Ask in English or Greek what is on, for example tonight in Nicosia, this weekend in Limassol or for kids on Sunday, and get upcoming events with dates, times, venue, city, entry (free or from a price) and a link to the full event page on eventshub.cy.

What you can do:
- Search upcoming events by keywords, dates, city and category
- See the details of an event: all dates, venue and address, price, organizer and description
- Browse the categories and cities eventshub covers

The data is public event information that organizers publish on eventshub. No account or sign-in is needed, the app is read-only and it never asks for or stores personal data. eventshub does not sell tickets: for bookings, follow the link to the event page.
capabilities: Search upcoming events in Cyprus by date, city and category
Event details: dates, venue, price, organizer and link
defaultPrompt: Things to do with kids in Cyprus on Sunday

positive.prompt: What concerts are on in Limassol this weekend?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events with Limassol, the music/concert category and this weekend's dates, and lists upcoming concerts with date, time, venue and a link to eventshub.cy.

positive.description: Family events on a specific day
positive.prompt: Find family-friendly things to do in Nicosia next Sunday.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events for Nicosia on next Sunday with family/kids events and returns a short list with times, venues and links.
Answers in Greek with tonight's events in Nicosia from search_events, each with time, venue and link.

positive.description: Search then details of one event
positive.prompt: Find a theatre play in Nicosia this month and give me the full details of one of them.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events for theatre in Nicosia, then get_event for one result, and shows all dates, venue and address, entry price, organizer and the event link.

positive.prompt: Which event categories and cities does eventshub cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_categories and list_cities and summarises the categories and Cyprus cities available.
